svg.text: Connection Lens — how one LinkedIn export becomes analytics
Everything below runs on one machine. No data leaves it, and nothing is scraped.
3 WAYS TO START A RUN — THE DAG BEHAVES IDENTICALLY FOR ALL THREE
The MD5 of the file’s bytes, checked against Bronze —
never the date, the upload time, or which trigger fired the run.
A duplicate upload is kept in MinIO for the audit trail,
skipped in Bronze, and logged loudly.
A redundant trigger is therefore a no-op by construction.
CI on synthetic fixtures, never real data
Great Expectations gate · dbt tests · sqlfluff
